title_zh: 记录软件故障的复现条件

scenario.label_zh: 记录软件故障复现条件而不夸大可靠性结论
scenario.goal_zh: 明确已复现的故障条件并约定按范围报告而不宣称全面评估

context_zh: 软件测试同事 Ivo 与 Selin 讨论自制笔记应用的测试结果，不涉及安全漏洞利用。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: I can readily reproduce the crash when I import this empty file.

sentences.speaker: Selin
sentences.text: Does it happen with ordinary files as well?

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: Not in the five examples I've tried.

sentences.speaker: Selin
sentences.text: Then don't turn this into a claim about the reliability of every import. Report the empty-file case and the tests you've actually run.

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: I'll attach the file and list those conditions. We can expand the test set tomorrow.
